description: Documentation file outlining the architecture, workflow, hooks, streaming, and lifecycle of the agent loop in OpenClaw, focusing on the internal processes, event flow, and session management.

methods.name: runEmbeddedPiAgent
methods.description: Runs the embedded Pi agent within a session, handles event subscription, timeout, and produces session payload.

methods.name: subscribeEmbeddedPiSession
methods.description: Bridges pi-agent-core events to OpenClaw stream events such as tool events, assistant increments, and lifecycle phases.

methods.name: waitForAgentJob
methods.description: Waits for the lifecycle events (end or error) of a specific agent run identified by runId.
